runtime_patch.lifecycle: The wrapper verifies and backs up the original module, applies the patch before any server starts, and restores the byte-identical original module through an EXIT trap. It refuses an unexpected or already patched source.

predecessor.result: second fresh start failed in the non-packed fused-sigmoid Triton GDN recurrence after one successful response

hypothesis.single_changed_variable_from_runtime_v2d: replace only non-speculative one-token GDN recurrent decode with an equivalent PyTorch implementation
hypothesis.rationale: The packed GDN decode kernel was implicated in prior JIT/failure evidence, and v2d then localized an illegal instruction to the only vLLM 0.27.1 fallback kernel. The patch avoids both recurrent-decode Triton kernels while retaining the causal-convolution kernel, prefill kernel, model weights, engine configuration, and request semantics.
hypothesis.supported_shape: continuous-batch, non-speculative, exactly one token per sequence; the frozen max_num_seqs=1 runtime satisfies this shape and all unsupported shapes fail closed

required_for_every_leg: expected complete serialized envelope and trace count
zero ProviderError, EngineCore, CUDA, CUBLAS, Triton, or RPC failure signatures
clean server teardown with idle GPUs
packed and fused-sigmoid Triton GDN decode JIT signatures absent

stronger_qualification_gate.pass_rule: All three sentinel starts and both five-task soaks pass.

stop_boundary: This is the last planned vLLM 0.27.1 same-host kernel hypothesis.
